privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: THE KLINIQUE keeps only the information needed to book and look after your appointments.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, your mobile number, your bookings and your chat messages with our consultants. We do not ask for anything else.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: To confirm your identity with an SMS code, to manage your appointments, and to answer your questions. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: How it is protected
sections.body: Data is sent over encrypted connections. SMS codes are stored only in scrambled form and expire after 5 minutes. Only clinic staff can see your bookings and messages.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time in My bookings. Your name, phone number and chat are then deleted. Past visits stay in the clinic's records without your personal details, as required for medical records.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about your data? Write to us in the Consult chat or visit us at Siam Square Soi 7, Bangkok.
